case_number: 2024 INSC 1008; CRIMINAL APPEAL ____________OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) NO.10447/2024)
summary: Witch-hunting accusations leading to public disrobing, assault, and abuse; dignity as constitutional value under Article 21; improper stay of criminal proceedings by High Court; withdrawal of quashing petition; witchcraft-related violence in rural areas; privacy concerns necessitating redaction of victims' names; need for expeditious trial in gender-based violence cases.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Art.14, Art.19, Art.21
final_judgment: Criminal Misc. petition withdrawn; High Court's unreasoned stay criticized; trial directed to proceed expeditiously.
